description: A128GCMKW on an oct key with key_ops [sign] and an oct key with key_ops [wrapKey] returns the wrapKey key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.4 (key_ops): with an alg and no key_op, key_ops must hold an operation A128GCMKW performs in either direction (wrapKey or unwrapKey); [sign] does not, [wrapKey] does; both are oct (§2.1), neither has alg or use; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
